_comment: Licence texts for shipped npm packages that publish none in their tarball.
MIT, ISC and the rest of the allow list require the copyright notice to
travel with the distributed binary. When a package omits it from its own
tarball, a link is not a substitute - so the text is vendored here from the
package's canonical source and reproduced in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
This file is the ONLY thing standing between a missing notice and a failed
audit: scripts/licenses/npm-licenses.mjs fails on any shipped package with no
licence text and no entry here. Adding an entry is therefore a deliberate,
reviewed act - fetch the text from the source URL, check it names a copyright
holder, and record where it came from. Do not add an entry to silence a
'covers' lists which parts of the package's SPDX expression each file
accounts for, so a compound expression cannot be half-satisfied unnoticed.

files.note: The published tarball contains only README.md, dist/ and package.json.
The published tarball contains only README.md, constants/, dist/ and package.json.
Victory's own MIT licence, covering the packaging.

The ISC half of `MIT AND ISC`: the package vendors d3-array, d3-color, d3-ease, d3-format, d3-interpolate, d3-path, d3-scale, d3-shape, d3-time and d3-timer, which share this text. Without it the ISC half of the expression would go unattributed.
